correctness.rationale: The universal all-prime property is equivalent to \(abc\) being a square in this squarefree nonsquare three-element domain, by Fried/F–R criterion and the Legendre-symbol product argument. Prime-support parity gives the unique \((uv,uw,vw)\) parameterization with \(u<v<w\) and \(\mu^2(uvw)=1\). The normalized region has volume \(2/3\); its w>B tail is \(O(N^{3/2}/B)\). The local squarefree probability is \((1-p^{-1})^3(1+3p^{-1})\). Fixed-modulus CRT equidistribution plus a large-prime union bound \(O(B^3N^{3/2}/Y)\) proves the asymptotic. Independent direct and factor counts agree for N=30,100,200,300; computations are corroborative only.
